Ayush Jaiswal vs State Of Uttar Pradesh And 3 Others on 16 October, 2025

Court No. - 4  HON'BLE AJIT KUMAR, J. 
HON'BLE SWARUPAMA CHATURVEDI, J.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Petitioner is aggrieved by order dated 23rd August, 2025 by respondent no. 3 under section 52 of of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
It is contended by learned Standing Counsel that against the order impugned, petitioner has an alternative efficacious remedy of appeal under Section 46(4) of the said Act.
Learned counsel for the petitioner does not dispute the same.

In the circumstances, we decline to grant indulgence in the matter at this stage, however, we still provide that in the event petitioner prefers appeal under the relevant provision of the Act within a period of four weeks from today, it shall be heard and disposed of within a further period of two months.
With the aforesaid observations and direction, this petition stands disposed of.
